headline: The mastering release: force, stretch, and the road back
highlights: The time stretch no longer shifts audio right: a warm-up inside the stretch engine was never compensated, so every stretched file gained ~100 ms of silence at the head. Content now lands within a couple of dozen SAMPLES of where it belongs, at every ratio.

Smart Stretch to Source — the premium stretch: finer analysis, consonants locked so speech never smears or doubles, pitch untouched to the cent, and the result lands on the source's duration to the exact frame. Beside the plain stretch in the duration fixes.
